messages:
vic: FYI: Compliance Attestation Portal is GA for Private/VPC customers as of today. This gives customers a self-serve place to download SOC2/ISO artifacts, submit evidence for audits, and request on-demand attestations. Short summary and action items below. :white_check_mark:
ela: Huge win 389. Does the portal require any tenant-side configuration?
jamal: Portal is read-only by default; tenants must opt into "artifact_sharing" to allow Redwood to surface artifacts. Opt-in API example in the rollout doc.
gwen: What's the retention policy for artifacts? Some customers asked for 7 years retention for audit artifacts.
jamal: Artifacts stored per-tenant with default 365 days retention; we added a per-tenant artifact_retention_days setting (up to 3650 days). Long-term storage is billed separately; CS will see cost estimates in the billing preview.
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: Note: for enterprise customers requesting 7-year retention, sign the archival addendum. See /legal/templates/artifact-archival.
ela: GTM: Can we get a short blurb and screenshots for customer emails + console help? I'd like a KB and a 1-pager by EOD.
csm-bot: PS-bot: We'll coordinate screenshots and customer messaging. CSMs, use /book-attestation-demo to schedule demos. Slots open Thu 10:00-12:00.
vic: Security note: access to portal artifacts is restricted to tenant admins and to Redwood SOC accounts; cross-tenant sharing is prohibited. We added an "attestation_audit" log type for every artifact download.
gwen: Any API endpoints for programmatic access?
jamal: Yes: GET /projects/:id/artifacts and POST /projects/:id/artifacts/export (signed URL zip). Example:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/111/artifacts
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: attestation-portal/ga -> prod completed on pool-5 at 1782903000 :rocket:
vic: Ops: we'll stream download events to tenant audit logs and (optionally) to customer SIEM via audit_forwarder_url. Make sure customers know about outbound webhooks if they enable it.
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: Legal requires the following notice added to portal UI: "Artifacts are provided for customer use in regulatory reviews; Redwood retains copies per customer settings. For archival service, please review the archival addendum." Please add before wider customer push.
ela: Action items: 1) UX add legal notice to portal (jamal + legal) 2) KB + screenshot pack (ela + csm-bot) 3) Update billing preview for archival pricing (finance) 4) Expose artifact_retention_days in console and API (eng) 5) Schedule customer demos (csm-bot).
gwen: One more request: add a CSV export of attestation logs for easy uploads to customer GRC tools.
jamal: Good call 44d. We'll add CSV export to the export endpoint next sprint.
vic: We'll run a 30-min post-release sweep at 16:00 PT to confirm audit streaming and portal permissions are behaving. Ping me if you see any unexpected public links or failed exports.
deploy-bot: monitoring-bot: post-deploy monitoring started at 1782903200; will report at 16:30 PT.
ela: Thanks team. If anything blocks your items, reply here and we'll escalate. We'll hold off customer-wide emails until legal notice is in place. :memo:
